The '''Starhawk 2b''' was a [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bike]] manufactured by [[Ikas-Adno/Legends|Ikas-Adno]]. While it was not the fastest speeder bike, it was one of the most graceful and was highly sought-after by collectors.
